briefing: Stocks fell broadly today: the NASDAQ dropped 1.6% and the S&P 500 fell 1.0%, so the screener flagged the market as risk-off and returned no buy candidates. We are making no trades. The 7 current positions stay open, and their automatic stop-loss and profit-target rules will handle any exits. The $445.88 in cash stays in reserve until a clear risk-on day.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A risk-off day is when investors get nervous and move money out of riskier assets like tech and growth stocks and into safer places. Opening new positions on a day like this can mean buying into further declines, so a disciplined investor often pauses new buys and lets existing risk controls such as stop-losses protect the portfolio. Waiting for the market mood to improve before putting in fresh money is a deliberate choice, not a missed opportunity.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「避險」（Risk-Off）是指投資者情緒轉趨謹慎，將資金從科技、成長股等高風險資產撤出，轉投較穩健的資產。在這種市況下建立新倉，容易在下跌途中接貨，因此有紀律的投資者往往暫停新買入，讓止蝕位等既有風險管理機制保護組合。等待市場氣氛回暖才再投入資金，是刻意的選擇，並非錯失機會。

market_education.summary_en: Major US indexes fell today. The tech-heavy NASDAQ dropped 1.6%, more than the S&P 500's 1.0% decline. When growth and tech stocks fall harder than the broad market, it usually means investors are cutting back on riskier, higher-valued names rather than selling everything. No news headlines came with today's data, so we can't point to a specific cause, and this is a description of the price action only.
market_education.summary_zh: 美股主要指數今日普遍下跌，以科技股為主的納斯達克指數跌1.6%，跌幅大於標普500指數的1.0%。科技及成長股跌幅明顯大於大市，通常反映資金正從高風險、高估值板塊撤出，而非全面拋售。由於今日數據未附帶相關新聞標題，未能確定具體觸發因素，以上僅就價格走勢作出描述。
